requests.prompt: Pixel-art animation reference storyboard for a tiny autonomous industrial Von Neumann harvesting probe in a dark paperclip factory, consistent with a restrained retro 2D platform game. One compact cold-steel octagonal chassis, a single horizontal scanning aperture (not a pair of eyes or a cute face), two short side guide rails and a pair of angular lower harvesting pincers. It is a functional floating machine, not an animal, skull, ball with wings, human robot or spaceship. Front-facing flat orthographic sprite in the side-scrolling gameplay plane; no perspective rotation. The chassis is rigid and identical in every panel. Imagine a32x32 sprite with pivot16,16: the entire silhouette must fit x3..28,y5..26; central housing about16x14, lower pincers clearly separated from the housing, short rail tips about26px total width. Light from upper left, selective1px dark-plum outline, cool reflective metal in3 hard bands, sparse grouped details, hard pixel edges, no anti-aliasing, smooth gradients, blur, bloom, texture noise or oversized antenna. Use this limited colour vocabulary: outline #2c2330; deep metal #34354f; metal shadows #575c79; metal mid #858eb0; restrained warm reflection #cbb696; highlight #d9ffea; scan indicator #9dded1; warning #e5c386; dark aperture #0f191b. Never use hero orange #d97757. Exactly4 equal-width panels in a single horizontal row, same scale and chassis centre line, fully separated by generous plain margins. Panel1: search state, pincers resting below the body, scan indicator on the left of the same narrow aperture. Panel2: same search pose, body and pincers unchanged, scan indicator on the right. Panel3: target-lock warning, same housing, two pincers open outward into a clearly wider fork; only the scan indicator turns pale amber. Panel4: consume pose, same housing, pincers close inward into a narrow V beneath the chassis; no debris or platform fragment. No extra clone or birth effect: real gameplay creates separate whole probes. Flat plain #808080 background across all panels; no scenery, ground, cast shadow, text, labels, numbers, arrows, panel borders or watermark. This is only a design reference; final exact32px native sprites will be manually redrawn later.
